claims: Monitor arterial blood pressure and titrate antihypertensive therapy as ordered.
Monitor heart rate and rhythm via continuous telemetry.
Continue supplemental oxygen at 2 L/min via nasal cannula and monitor SpO2.
Monitor serum potassium and continue potassium chloride replacement infusion.
Monitor point-of-care blood glucose and treat hyperglycemia per protocol.
Assess right lower extremity strength and mobility with each nursing assessment.
Reposition and turn patient in bed every 2 hours.
Perform oral care and maintain nothing-by-mouth status until swallowing safety is confirmed.
Monitor level of consciousness and delirium screening with CAM-ICU each shift.
Maintain indwelling arterial line and ensure dressing remains occlusive and calibrated.
